source_refs.note: Topic 23.2 (PDF 103). The iodoform example of an alpha-carbon reaction is taken from topic 23.3.2.

blocks.text: The carbonyl group governs the chemistry of aldehydes and ketones. They have two basic kinds of reaction: nucleophilic addition reactions at the C=O group, and reactions specific to the alpha carbon (the carbon next to the carbonyl group), such as the iodoform reaction of CH3CO- compounds.
